description: This Java source file defines the EncodedStringValue class, which represents an encoded string value used in SMS/MMS messaging. It provides constructors, getters, setters, cloning, string representation, and utility methods for handling encoded strings with specific character sets.

classes.name: EncodedStringValue
classes.description: Represents an encoded string (such as a text message or part of one) with a specified character set. It supports cloning, concatenation, splitting, and encoding functionality.

methods.name: EncodedStringValue
methods.description: Constructor initializing with charset and byte array data.

methods.name: EncodedStringValue
methods.description: Constructor initializing with byte array data, defaults charset to DEFAULT_CHARSET.

methods.name: EncodedStringValue
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a String, converts to bytes using default charset.

methods.name: getCharacterSet
methods.description: Returns the character set of the encoded string.

methods.name: setCharacterSet
methods.description: Sets the character set for the encoded string.

methods.name: getTextString
methods.description: Returns a copy of the byte array representing the encoded text string.

methods.name: setTextString
methods.description: Sets the byte array representing the encoded text string.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Decodes the byte array into a Java String using the specified character set.

methods.name: appendTextString
methods.description: Appends additional byte data to the current text string.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this EncodedStringValue instance.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the encoded string into parts around a pattern string.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Creates an array of EncodedStringValue objects from a semicolon-separated string.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates an array of EncodedStringValue objects into a single semicolon-separated String.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a given EncodedStringValue.

methods.name: encodeStrings
methods.description: Encodes an array of String objects into an array of EncodedStringValue objects.
